scientific_integrity: Global root-count proof, exact boundary treatment, differentiability and signed derivative calculations, with standalone standard-library reproducibility checks. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: One-step real predecessor geometry only; a,k,h positive and b=-k,c=-h; does not classify forward attractors, other coefficient signs, longer inverse trees or security. Nonsmooth switching preimages are counted but do not have ordinary Jacobian determinants except at the differentiable origin.
title: Exact three-sheet inverse geometry of an absolute-value planar map
